policy.source: EXPERIMENT_SPEC.md sections 2–5; DECISIONS.md D26–D29; GEOMETRY.md contact policy
policy.orderGrouping: sorted bins spanning at most 1% of sheet length / 1 degree
policy.symmetry: palindromic lengths within 1% of sheet length AND angles within 1 degree
policy.spread: 180 degrees minus largest fold angle; 180 degrees with no folds; numerical tolerance 1e-9 degree
policy.budgets: every answer checked; consecutive minFolds through minFolds + 2, capped at 11; folds <= budget
policy.scope: checks saved designs and scores; does not establish global ranking optimality or continuous collision freedom
